summary.text: Pebblin Warren represents House District 82 (Lee and Macon Counties) in the Alabama House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: She was first elected in a special election held on March 8, 2005.
The legislature's profile says she holds a B.S. in business administration and an M.Ed. in personnel administration from Tuskegee University.
